<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Gofans.co</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
--navy:#404040; --navy-2:#595959; --gold:#e2e4e6; --gold-dark:#c7cacd;
--cream:#ffffff; --paper:#ffffff; --ink:#181b22; --ink-soft:#5b6270;
--line:#dcdde0; --danger:#a1372f; --ok:#3d7a4f;
--radius:10px;
box-sizing:border-box;
padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
*{box-sizing:inherit;}
/* Site is always light/white regardless of device dark mode setting */
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); height:100%;}
body{
height:100%;
margin:0; background:var(--cream); color:var(--ink);
font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; line-height:1.5;
}
h1,h2,h3,.brand{font-family:'Oswald',system-ui,sans-serif;}
.wrap{max-width:760px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 20px;}
header{
background:#2b2b2b; color:#fff;
padding:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) 0 0 0;
position:sticky; top:0; z-index:10; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.headbar{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:relative; padding:14px 20px;}
.back-icon{
position:absolute; left:14px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%);
background:none; border:none; color:#fff; font-size:1.5rem; line-height:1;
cursor:pointer; padding:4px 10px;
}
.brand{font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.5px; color:var(--ink); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;}
.brand .mark{width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; background:#2e7d32; color:#000; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; border:1.5px solid #000;}
.tabs{display:flex; gap:4px; justify-content:center; background:var(--paper); padding:8px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
nav button{
background:none; border:none; color:var(--ink-soft); font:inherit; font-size:.92rem;
padding:8px 16px; border-radius:20px; cursor:pointer;
}
nav button.active{background:var(--gold); color:var(--navy); font-weight:600;}
main{padding:28px 0 60px;}
.hero{padding:8px 0 26px;}
.hero h1{font-size:1.9rem; margin:0 0 6px; line-height:1.15;}
.hero p{color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0; max-width:46ch;}
.section-title{font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:600; margin:0 0 14px; color:var(--ink);}
.card{
background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--line); border-left:4px solid var(--navy); border-radius:var(--radius);
padding:16px 18px; margin-bottom:12px;
}
.event{display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center;}
.event .team-logo{
flex:0 0 52px; width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover;
background:var(--navy); border:1px solid var(--line);
}
.event .info{flex:1; min-width:0;}
.event .info h3{margin:0 0 2px; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.25;}
.event .info .meta{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.86rem;}
.event .buy{flex:0 0 auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-end; gap:6px;}
.price{font-weight:600; font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem;}
button.primary{
background:var(--gold); color:var(--navy); border:none; font:inherit; font-weight:600;
padding:9px 16px; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; font-size:.9rem;
}
button.primary:hover{background:var(--gold-dark);}
button.ghost{
background:none; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); font:inherit;
padding:8px 14px; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; font-size:.85rem;
}
.empty{color:var(--ink-soft); font-style:italic; padding:20px 0;}

.alert{
display:flex; gap:12px; background:#fdf3d6; border-left:4px solid #e3c04a;
padding:14px 16px; border-radius:6px; margin-bottom:20px; position:relative;
}
.alert .a-icon{
flex:0 0 20px; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:50%; background:#e3c04a;
color:#3b3f45; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.alert .a-body{flex:1;}
.alert .a-title{font-weight:700; margin-bottom:4px; font-size:.94rem;}
.alert .a-text{font-size:.86rem; color:#4a4530; line-height:1.4;}
.alert .a-close{
position:absolute; top:10px; right:12px; background:none; border:none; font-size:1rem;
cursor:pointer; color:#4a4530;
}
.alert.hidden{display:none;}

.phone-bar{
display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:var(--line); color:var(--ink);
padding:12px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:600; font-size:.9rem; margin-bottom:16px;
}
.phone-bar .p-icon{
flex:0 0 18px; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; border:1.5px solid var(--ink);
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:.7rem;
}
.ticket-option{
border:1px solid var(--line); border-left:4px solid var(--navy); border-radius:8px;
display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px;
}
.ticket-option .t-name{font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; margin-bottom:2px;}
.ticket-option .t-price{font-size:.95rem;}
.ticket-option .t-fee{font-size:.76rem; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.stepper{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:8px 14px;}
.stepper button{
background:none; border:none; font-size:1.1rem; width:22px; height:22px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink);
}
.stepper .s-mid{text-align:center;}
.stepper .s-label{font-size:.68rem; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.stepper .s-value{font-weight:600; font-size:1.05rem;}
.disclaimer{text-align:center; font-size:.76rem; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:14px; line-height:1.5;}

.subtabs{display:flex; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:18px;}
.subtabs button{
flex:1; background:var(--paper); border:none; padding:12px; font:inherit; font-weight:600; font-size:.9rem;
color:var(--ink-soft); cursor:pointer; border-right:1px solid var(--line);
}
.subtabs button:last-child{border-right:none;}
.subtabs button.sub-active{background:var(--line); color:var(--ink);}
.sub-count{
display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:18px; height:18px;
border-radius:50%; background:var(--ink-soft); color:#fff; font-size:.68rem; margin-right:4px;
}

.use-screen{
position:fixed; inset:0; background:var(--paper); z-index:70; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
}
.use-screen.hidden{display:none;}
.use-top{
display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 20px 14px;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.use-top .title{flex:1; text-align:center; font-weight:700; font-size:1.1rem; margin-right:34px;}
.use-banner{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:16px 20px; color:#fff;}
.use-banner img{width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; object-fit:contain; padding:3px;}
.use-banner .u-name{font-weight:700; font-size:1.02rem;}
.use-banner .u-sport{font-size:.82rem; opacity:.9;}
.use-body{flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:24px 20px; text-align:center;}
.use-qty{
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:30px; font-weight:700; font-size:1.1rem;
}
.use-qty .q-circle{
width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--line); display:flex; align-items:center;
justify-content:center; font-size:.95rem;
}
.use-clockwrap{position:relative; margin:0 auto 34px; width:180px; height:180px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;}
.use-clockwrap img{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; opacity:.12;}
.use-clock{position:relative; font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif; font-size:1.6rem; font-weight:600;}
.use-warn{background:var(--cream); padding:26px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.use-warn .hand{
width:48px; height:48px; margin:0 auto 14px; border-radius:12px; background:#c0392b; color:#fff;
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.4rem;
}
.use-warn h3{margin:0 0 6px; font-size:1.1rem;}
.use-warn p{margin:0 0 18px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.88rem;}
.use-warn button.go{
width:100%; background:#2e9c4f; color:#fff; border:none; padding:14px; border-radius:8px;
font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer; margin-bottom:10px;
}
.use-warn button.cancel{
width:100%; background:none; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); padding:13px; border-radius:8px;
font:inherit; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; margin-bottom:12px;
}
.use-final{text-align:center; font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.processing-overlay{
position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,.25); z-index:80; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.processing-overlay.hidden{display:none;}
.processing-box{
background:var(--paper); border-radius:10px; padding:30px 40px; text-align:center; font-weight:700;
}
.spinner{
width:30px; height:30px; border:3px solid var(--line); border-top-color:var(--ink); border-radius:50%;
margin:0 auto 12px; animation:spin .8s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}
.success-screen{
position:fixed; inset:0; background:var(--paper); z-index:90; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; padding:20px;
animation:fadeIn .25s ease;
}
.success-screen.hidden{display:none;}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;} to{opacity:1;}}
.success-icon{position:relative; width:64px; height:64px; margin-bottom:22px;}
.success-check{
position:absolute; bottom:-6px; right:-10px; width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%;
background:#2e9c4f; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; border:3px solid var(--paper);
}
.success-title{font-weight:700; font-size:1.15rem; margin-bottom:6px;}
.success-sub{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.9rem; margin-bottom:18px;}
.success-note{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.86rem;}
.success-done{
margin-top:28px; width:100%; max-width:280px; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; border:none;
padding:13px; border-radius:8px; font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:.96rem; cursor:pointer;
}

.ticket{
position:relative; background:var(--paper); border:2px solid #2e9c4f; border-radius:14px;
display:flex; margin-bottom:26px; overflow:visible;
}
.ticket.used{border-color:var(--line);}
.ticket .tk-check{
position:absolute; top:-10px; right:-10px; width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%;
background:var(--paper); color:transparent; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; border:3px solid var(--cream); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--line);
cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, color .15s;
}
.ticket .tk-check.selected{background:#2e9c4f; color:#fff; box-shadow:none;}
.ticket.used .tk-check{display:none;}
.bulk-bar{
position:sticky; bottom:0; padding:12px 0 calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); background:var(--cream);
}
.bulk-bar.hidden{display:none;}
.bulk-bar .bulk-go{
width:100%; background:#2e9c4f; color:#fff; border:none; padding:14px; border-radius:8px;
font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer;
}
.ticket::before, .ticket::after{
content:''; position:absolute; left:38px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%;
background:var(--cream); border:2px solid #2e9c4f;
}
.ticket.used::before, .ticket.used::after{border-color:var(--line);}
.ticket::before{top:-10px;}
.ticket::after{bottom:-10px;}
.tk-stub{
flex:0 0 46px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px;
border-right:2px dashed var(--line); padding:14px 0;
}
.tk-stub span{
writing-mode:vertical-rl; transform:rotate(180deg); letter-spacing:.06em;
}
.tk-stub .tk-admit{font-weight:800; font-size:.74rem;}
.tk-stub .tk-sport{font-size:.7rem; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.tk-main{flex:1; padding:16px 18px;}
.tk-ga{font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; margin-bottom:10px;}
.tk-banner{
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border-radius:8px;
padding:12px 14px; color:#fff; margin-bottom:12px; gap:10px;
}
.tk-banner .tk-banner-text strong{display:block; font-size:.94rem; line-height:1.3;}
.tk-banner .tk-banner-text div{font-size:.8rem; opacity:.9; margin-top:4px;}
.tk-logo{width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; object-fit:contain; padding:3px; flex:0 0 38px;}
.tk-footer{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:.78rem; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:4px;}
.tk-footer .status{
display:inline-block; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; padding:3px 8px;
border-radius:20px; letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.status.valid{background:#e4f1e6; color:var(--ok);}
.status.used{background:#ece9e2; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.status.transferred{background:#e9eaeb; color:var(--navy-2);}
.ticket .actions{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:10px;}
.qr-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-top:10px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.qr{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:2px; width:44px; height:44px; flex:0 0 44px;}
.qr div{background:var(--ink);}
.qr div.off{background:transparent;}
.code{font-size:.62rem; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:monospace;}

.overlay{
position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(10,12,18,.55); display:flex; align-items:flex-end;
justify-content:center; z-index:50; padding:0;
}
.overlay.hidden{display:none;}
.sheet{
background:var(--paper); width:100%; max-width:460px; border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;
padding:22px 22px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
max-height:85vh; overflow-y:auto;
}
.sheet h2{margin:0 0 4px; font-size:1.2rem;}
.sheet .sub{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.88rem; margin-bottom:16px;}
.field{margin-bottom:14px;}
.field label{display:block; font-size:.84rem; font-weight:500; margin-bottom:5px;}
.field input,.field select{
width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px;
font:inherit; background:var(--cream); color:var(--ink);
}
.sheet-actions{display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:18px;}
.sheet-actions button{flex:1; padding:11px; border-radius:8px; font:inherit; cursor:pointer;}
.toast{
position:fixed; bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
background:var(--navy); color:#f4ede1; padding:11px 20px; border-radius:30px; font-size:.88rem;
z-index:60; opacity:0; transition:opacity .25s, transform .25s; pointer-events:none;
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
<div class="headbar">
<button class="back-icon" style="visibility:hidden;">‹</button>
<div class="brand"><img id="brandLogoMain" alt="GoFans" style="height:22px; width:auto; display:block;"></div>
</div>
<div class="tabs">
<button id="navHome" class="active">Games</button>
<button id="navTickets">My Tickets</button>
</div>
</header>

<main class="wrap">
<div id="homeView">
<div class="hero">
<h1>Every home game. One tap to get in.</h1>
<p>Buy a ticket, transfer it to a friend, or pull it up at the gate — no account, no app download, no waiting on a page to load.</p>
</div>
<div class="section-title">Upcoming home games</div>
<div id="eventList"></div>
</div>

<div id="ticketsView" style="display:none;">
<div class="alert" id="homeAlert">
<div class="a-icon">!</div>
<div class="a-body">
<div class="a-title">Event Alert</div>
<div class="a-text">Good sportsmanship is a condition of entry at every MCPS athletic event. Spectators are expected to be respectful toward players, officials, and fans from both schools.</div>
</div>
<button class="a-close" onclick="document.getElementById('homeAlert').classList.add('hidden')">✕</button>
</div>
<div class="section-title" style="margin-top:8px;">My tickets</div>
<div class="subtabs">
<button id="subAvailable" class="sub-active" onclick="switchTicketTab('available')">Available</button>
<button id="subUsed" onclick="switchTicketTab('used')">
<span class="sub-count" id="usedCount">0</span> Used
</button>
</div>
<div id="ticketList"></div>
<div id="bulkBar" class="bulk-bar hidden">
<button class="bulk-go" id="bulkGoBtn" onclick="openBulkUse()">Use 1 ticket</button>
</div>
</div>
</main>

<div class="overlay hidden" id="buyOverlay">
<div class="sheet">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin:-22px -22px 16px; padding:14px 20px; background:#2b2b2b; color:#fff; border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;">
<button class="back-icon" style="position:static; color:#fff;" onclick="closeSheet('buyOverlay')">‹</button>
<div class="brand" style="font-size:1rem;"><img id="brandLogoSheet" alt="GoFans" style="height:18px; width:auto; display:block;"></div>
</div>
<div class="alert" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
<div class="a-icon">!</div>
<div class="a-body">
<div class="a-title" style="font-size:.86rem;">Event Alert</div>
<div class="a-text" style="font-size:.78rem;">Please arrive 15 minutes early. Your phone is your ticket — no printing needed.</div>
</div>
</div>
<h2 id="buyTitle" style="font-size:1.05rem;">Get tickets</h2>
<div class="sub" id="buySub"></div>
<div class="phone-bar"><span class="p-icon">i</span> Your phone is your ticket</div>
<div class="ticket-option">
<div>
<div class="t-name">General Admission</div>
<div class="t-price" id="buyPrice">$5</div>
<div class="t-fee" id="buyFee">$4 price + $1 fee</div>
</div>
<div class="stepper">
<button onclick="stepQty(-1)">–</button>
<div class="s-mid"><div class="s-label">Quantity</div><div class="s-value" id="buyQtyValue">1</div></div>
<button onclick="stepQty(1)">+</button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field"><label>Your name</label><input id="buyName" placeholder="e.g. Alex Rivera"></div>
<button class="primary" style="width:100%; padding:13px;" onclick="confirmBuy()">Add to cart</button>
<div class="disclaimer">Additional taxes may apply.<br>All purchases are non-refundable.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="overlay hidden" id="transferOverlay">
<div class="sheet">
<h2>Transfer ticket</h2>
<div class="sub">The recipient gets full access to this ticket. You'll lose access to it.</div>
<div class="field"><label>Recipient name</label><input id="transferName" placeholder="e.g. Jordan Lee"></div>
<div class="sheet-actions">
<button class="ghost" onclick="closeSheet('transferOverlay')">Cancel</button>
<button class="primary" onclick="confirmTransfer()">Send ticket</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<div class="use-screen hidden" id="useScreen">
<div class="use-top">
<button class="back-icon" style="position:static; color:var(--ink);" onclick="closeUseScreen()">‹</button>
<div class="title">My tickets</div>
</div>
<div class="use-banner" id="useBanner">
<img id="useLogo" src="" alt="">
<div>
<div class="u-name" id="useName"></div>
<div class="u-sport" id="useSport"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="use-body">
<div class="use-qty"><span class="q-circle" id="useQtyCircle">1</span> General Admission</div>
<div class="use-clockwrap">
<img id="useLogoFaded" src="" alt="">
<div class="use-clock" id="useClock">--:--:-- --</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="use-warn">
<div class="hand">✋</div>
<h3>Authorized staff only</h3>
<p>You must use ONSITE for entry into venue.</p>
<button class="go" id="useConfirmBtn" onclick="confirmUseTicket()">Use 1 ticket</button>
<button class="cancel" onclick="closeUseScreen()">Cancel</button>
<div class="use-final">All redemptions final</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="processing-overlay hidden" id="processingOverlay">
<div class="processing-box"><div class="spinner"></div>Processing...</div>
</div>

<div class="success-screen hidden" id="successScreen">
<div class="success-icon">
<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="64" height="64">
<path d="M8 20 a4 4 0 0 1 4-4 h32 a4 4 0 0 1 4 4 v4 a5 5 0 0 0 0 8 v4 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 4 h-32 a4 4 0 0 1 -4-4 v-4 a5 5 0 0 0 0-8 z" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)" stroke-width="2.2"/>
<line x1="26" y1="17" x2="26" y2="47" stroke="var(--ink)" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
</svg>
<div class="success-check">✓</div>
</div>
<div class="success-title" id="successTitle">1 ticket used!</div>
<div class="success-sub" id="successSub">Event name</div>
<div class="success-note">Have fun and enjoy the event!</div>
<button class="success-done" onclick="closeSuccessScreen()">Done</button>
</div>

<script>
const GOFANS_LOGO = "data:image/png;base64,";
const LOGO_WHEATON = "data:image/png;base64,";
const LOGO_BLAIR = "data:image/png;base64,";
const LOGO_PAINTBRANCH = "data:image/png;base64,";
const EVENTS = [
{id:'fb1', logo: LOGO_BLAIR, host:'Montgomery Blair High School', sport:'Football', level:'Boys Varsity', opp:'Montgomery Blair Blazers vs Walt Whitman Vikings', date:'Fri, Oct 09, 2026', month:'OCT', day:'9', time:'6:30 PM', place:'6:30 PM', price:5, fee:'$4 price + $1 fee', bannerColor:'#d92b1f'},
{id:'fb2', logo: LOGO_WHEATON, host:'Wheaton High School', sport:'Football', level:'Boys Varsity/JV', opp:'Wheaton Knights vs John F Kennedy Cavaliers', date:'Fri, Oct 23, 2026', month:'OCT', day:'23', time:'4:15 PM', place:'4:15 PM', price:5, fee:'$4 price + $1 fee', bannerColor:'#a3161c'},
{id:'fb3', logo: LOGO_PAINTBRANCH, host:'Paint Branch High School', sport:'Football', level:'Boys Varsity', opp:'Paint Branch Panthers vs Springbrook Blue Devils', date:'Fri, Oct 09, 2026', month:'OCT', day:'9', time:'6:30 PM', place:'6:30 PM', price:5, fee:'$4 price + $1 fee', bannerColor:'#702030'},
{id:'fb4', logo: LOGO_WHEATON, host:'Wheaton High School', sport:'Football', level:'Boys Varsity/JV', opp:'Wheaton Knights vs Richard Montgomery Rockets', date:'Fri, Oct 02, 2026', month:'OCT', day:'2', time:'4:15 PM', place:'4:15 PM', price:5, fee:'$4 price + $1 fee', bannerColor:'#a3161c'},
];

let tickets = [];
try{ tickets = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('whs_tickets')||'[]'); }catch(e){ tickets = []; }
function save(){ try{ localStorage.setItem('whs_tickets', JSON.stringify(tickets)); }catch(e){} }

function renderEvents(){
const el = document.getElementById('eventList');
el.innerHTML = EVENTS.map(ev => `
<div class="card event">
<img class="team-logo" src="${ev.logo}" alt="${ev.host} logo">
<div class="info">
<div class="meta" style="margin-bottom:2px;">${ev.host} Events</div>
<h3>${ev.opp}</h3>
<div class="meta">${ev.sport} - ${ev.level}</div>
<div class="meta">${ev.date} at ${ev.time}</div>
</div>
<div class="buy">
<div class="price">$${ev.price}</div>
<div class="meta" style="font-size:.72rem;">${ev.fee}</div>
<button class="primary" onclick="openBuy('${ev.id}')">Buy</button>
</div>
</div>`).join('');
}

function qrGrid(seed){
let h = 0;
for(let i=0;i<seed.length;i++) h = (h*31 + seed.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
let cells = '';
for(let i=0;i<49;i++){
h = (h*1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0;
const on = (i===0||i===6||i===42||i===3||i===45||i===21) ? true : (h % 3 !== 0);
cells += `<div class="${on?'':'off'}"></div>`;
}
return cells;
}

let ticketTab = 'available';
let selectedTickets = new Set();
function switchTicketTab(tab){
ticketTab = tab;
selectedTickets.clear();
document.getElementById('subAvailable').classList.toggle('sub-active', tab==='available');
document.getElementById('subUsed').classList.toggle('sub-active', tab==='used');
renderTickets();
}
function toggleSelect(id){
if(selectedTickets.has(id)) selectedTickets.delete(id); else selectedTickets.add(id);
renderTickets();
}
function updateBulkBar(){
const bar = document.getElementById('bulkBar');
const n = selectedTickets.size;
if(n === 0){ bar.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
bar.classList.remove('hidden');
document.getElementById('bulkGoBtn').textContent = `Use ${n} ticket${n>1?'s':''}`;
}
function renderTickets(){
const el = document.getElementById('ticketList');
const owned = tickets.filter(t => EVENTS.some(e => e.id === t.eventId) && t.status !== 'transferred');
document.getElementById('usedCount').textContent = owned.filter(t => t.status === 'used').length;
const shown = owned.filter(t => ticketTab === 'used' ? t.status === 'used' : t.status === 'valid').slice().reverse();
updateBulkBar();
if(shown.length === 0){
el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${ticketTab === 'used' ? 'No used tickets yet.' : 'No tickets available — grab one from the Games tab.'}</div>`;
return;
}
el.innerHTML = shown.map(t => {
const ev = EVENTS.find(e => e.id === t.eventId);
const used = t.status === 'used';
const footer = used
? `<span class="status used">Used: ${t.usedAt}</span>`
: `<span class="status valid">Valid</span><span>1 of ${t.qty} · ${t.holder}</span>`;
const actions = !used ? `
<div class="actions">
<button class="ghost" onclick="openTransfer('${t.id}')">Transfer</button>
<button class="primary" onclick="openUseTicket(['${t.id}'])">Use ticket</button>
</div>` : '';
const selected = selectedTickets.has(t.id);
return `
<div class="ticket ${used ? 'used' : ''}">
<div class="tk-check ${selected ? 'selected' : ''}" ${used ? '' : `onclick="toggleSelect('${t.id}')"`}>✓</div>
<div class="tk-stub">
<span class="tk-admit">ADMIT ONE</span>
<span class="tk-sport">${ev.sport}</span>
</div>
<div class="tk-main">
<div class="tk-ga">General Admission</div>
<div class="tk-banner" style="background:${ev.bannerColor}; ${used ? 'filter:grayscale(35%) brightness(1.2);' : ''}">
<div class="tk-banner-text">
<strong>${ev.opp}</strong>
<div>${ev.date} at ${ev.time}</div>
</div>
<img class="tk-logo" src="${ev.logo}" alt="">
</div>
<div class="tk-footer">${footer}</div>
${actions}
</div>
</div>`;
}).join('');
}

let pendingEventId = null, pendingTicketId = null, buyQty = 1;
function stepQty(delta){
buyQty = Math.min(8, Math.max(1, buyQty + delta));
document.getElementById('buyQtyValue').textContent = buyQty;
}
function openBuy(eventId){
pendingEventId = eventId;
buyQty = 1;
const ev = EVENTS.find(e => e.id === eventId);
document.getElementById('buyTitle').textContent = ev.opp;
document.getElementById('buySub').textContent = `${ev.sport} - ${ev.level} · ${ev.date} at ${ev.time}`;
document.getElementById('buyPrice').textContent = `$${ev.price}`;
document.getElementById('buyFee').textContent = ev.fee;
document.getElementById('buyQtyValue').textContent = '1';
document.getElementById('buyName').value = '';
document.getElementById('buyOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function confirmBuy(){
const name = document.getElementById('buyName').value.trim() || 'Guest';
for(let i=0; i<buyQty; i++){
const id = 'WHS-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8).toUpperCase();
tickets.push({id, eventId: pendingEventId, holder: name, qty: 1, status: 'valid'});
}
save(); renderTickets(); closeSheet('buyOverlay');
showToast(buyQty > 1 ? `${buyQty} tickets added — each ready separately in My Tickets` : 'Added to cart — ticket ready in My Tickets');
switchView('tickets');
}
function openTransfer(ticketId){
pendingTicketId = ticketId;
document.getElementById('transferName').value = '';
document.getElementById('transferOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function confirmTransfer(){
const name = document.getElementById('transferName').value.trim();
if(!name){ return; }
tickets = tickets.filter(t => t.id !== pendingTicketId);
save(); renderTickets(); closeSheet('transferOverlay');
showToast(`Ticket transferred to ${name}`);
}
let clockTimer = null;
let pendingTicketIds = [];
function openUseTicket(ticketIds){
pendingTicketIds = ticketIds;
const first = tickets.find(x => x.id === ticketIds[0]);
const ev = EVENTS.find(e => e.id === first.eventId);
const sameEvent = ticketIds.every(id => tickets.find(x => x.id === id).eventId === first.eventId);
document.getElementById('useBanner').style.background = sameEvent ? ev.bannerColor : 'var(--navy)';
document.getElementById('useLogo').src = sameEvent ? ev.logo : LOGO_WHEATON;
document.getElementById('useLogoFaded').src = sameEvent ? ev.logo : LOGO_WHEATON;
document.getElementById('useName').textContent = sameEvent ? ev.opp : 'Selected tickets';
document.getElementById('useSport').textContent = sameEvent ? ev.sport : `${ticketIds.length} different events`;
document.getElementById('useQtyCircle').textContent = ticketIds.length;
document.getElementById('useConfirmBtn').textContent = `Use ${ticketIds.length} ticket${ticketIds.length>1?'s':''}`;
document.getElementById('useScreen').classList.remove('hidden');
tickClock();
clockTimer = setInterval(tickClock, 1000);
}
function openBulkUse(){
if(selectedTickets.size === 0) return;
openUseTicket([...selectedTickets]);
}
function tickClock(){
document.getElementById('useClock').textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit', second:'2-digit'});
}
function closeUseScreen(){
clearInterval(clockTimer);
document.getElementById('useScreen').classList.add('hidden');
}
function confirmUseTicket(){
document.getElementById('processingOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
setTimeout(() => {
const stamp = new Date().toLocaleString([], {weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'});
const n = pendingTicketIds.length;
const firstEv = EVENTS.find(e => e.id === tickets.find(x => x.id === pendingTicketIds[0]).eventId);
const sameEvent = pendingTicketIds.every(id => tickets.find(x => x.id === id).eventId === firstEv.id);
pendingTicketIds.forEach(id => {
const t = tickets.find(x => x.id === id);
t.status = 'used';
t.usedAt = stamp;
});
save();
selectedTickets.clear();
document.getElementById('processingOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
clearInterval(clockTimer);
document.getElementById('useScreen').classList.add('hidden');
switchTicketTab('used');
document.getElementById('successTitle').textContent = `${n} ticket${n>1?'s':''} used!`;
document.getElementById('successSub').textContent = sameEvent ? firstEv.opp : `${n} tickets across multiple events`;
document.getElementById('successScreen').classList.remove('hidden');
successTimer = setTimeout(closeSuccessScreen, 2500);
}, 1100);
}
let successTimer = null;
function closeSuccessScreen(){
clearTimeout(successTimer);
document.getElementById('successScreen').classList.add('hidden');
}
function closeSheet(id){ document.getElementById(id).classList.add('hidden'); }
function showToast(msg){
const el = document.getElementById('toast');
el.textContent = msg; el.classList.add('show');
clearTimeout(showToast._t);
showToast._t = setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
}
function switchView(view){
const home = view === 'home';
document.getElementById('homeView').style.display = home ? '' : 'none';
document.getElementById('ticketsView').style.display = home ? 'none' : '';
document.getElementById('navHome').classList.toggle('active', home);
document.getElementById('navTickets').classList.toggle('active', !home);
}
document.getElementById('navHome').onclick = () => switchView('home');
document.getElementById('navTickets').onclick = () => switchView('tickets');

renderEvents();
renderTickets();
document.getElementById('brandLogoMain').src = GOFANS_LOGO;
document.getElementById('brandLogoSheet').src = GOFANS_LOGO;
</script>
</body>
</html>
